prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign), path selection redesigns (choose_path, redesign), and path copy reframing (choose_path, copy) proved helpful, each delivering a winning test.
Sign-in hints (sign_in, hint), waiting screen info updates (home, wait_info), and waiting screen notifications (home, notification) consistently showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
New finish screens (finish, new_screen), finish redesigns (finish, redesign), sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder), and sign-in layout changes (sign_in, layout) produced no winning tests, resulting in no clear effect or worse outcomes.
Evidence remains thin for single-test categories, including adoption new flows, adoption incentives, path selection layouts, finish notifications, home screen layouts, and home screen redesigns.
Predictions were generally overly optimistic, though they underestimated the impact of winning path selection redesigns and copy changes.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Stage Layout Redesign for Pick Friend Screen: Redesign the pick_friend screen using a stage layout with prominent companion visual choices and animated character highlights. (why: Adoption stage experiences a high drop-off of 34.1% and long median duration (89s); earlier lessons showed adoption redesigns deliver clear wins.)
1: [choose_path, new_flow] Companion Match Assessment Sub-Flow: Insert a short companion match screen before path selection to help users find the pet style that fits their workflow. (why: Path selection has a mean completion time of 514s; providing structured matching guidance builds early engagement and speeds up decision making.)
2: [adoption, redesign] Compact Photo Upload Screen Redesign: Redesign the custom photo upload screen with a compact layout and direct photo selection controls. (why: Support tickets highlight custom pet creation failures, contributing to adoption friction and user abandonment.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Companion Trait Preference Sub-Flow: Add a companion demeanor preference screen prior to adoption certificate confirmation. (why: Customizing companion personality traits increases user investment right before adoption confirmation, reducing the 34.1% adoption drop-off.)
4: [choose_path, redesign] Visual Stage Redesign for Onboarding Story Intro: Redesign the initial welcome story screen into a stage layout featuring animated desktop pet visuals. (why: Past results confirm early path and story redesigns drive stronger initial funnel conversion.)
5: [adoption, copy] Frictionless Companion Selection Copy Reframing: Update copy on pick_friend screen to emphasize instant zero-setup adoption and immediate desktop availability. (why: Adoption mean time is over 1000s; reassuring users about quick companion readiness reduces drop-off.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Focus Companion Story Copy Reframing: Update story screen headline and body to frame the desktop pet as a soothing study and work companion. (why: Path copy reframing was proven effective in earlier tests to improve early funnel conversion.)
